patterns.comment: Block comment. The form documented in the ILE Concepts manual; may span lines. Scoped comment.line to match the CL grammar's convention.
patterns.name: comment.line.bnd

patterns.comment: Double-dash line comment. Accepted by the binder but absent from the ILE Concepts manual. SEU flags both comment styles as errors even though the binder accepts them.
patterns.name: comment.line.bnd

patterns.comment: Numeric literals, such as the version digits inside a signature string.
patterns.name: constant.numeric.bnd

patterns.comment: Special values: *CURRENT and *PRV for PGMLVL, *YES and *NO for LVLCHK, *GEN for SIGNATURE.
patterns.name: constant.language.bnd

patterns.comment: The three binder language commands. A member may contain several STRPGMEXP/ENDPGMEXP blocks, one per signature level.
patterns.name: keyword.other.bnd

patterns.comment: Wildcard characters in EXPORT SYMBOL, e.g. SYMBOL(interest>>>)
patterns.name: keyword.other.bnd

patterns.comment: Hexadecimal signature, e.g. SIGNATURE(X'0000...FFFF'). A signature is at most 16 bytes.
patterns.name: string.other.bnd.hex

patterns.comment: Quoted symbol name or character signature. Quoting preserves case; an unquoted symbol name is folded to uppercase by the binder.
patterns.name: string.quoted.single.bnd

patterns.comment: Backslash escapes are not part of binder language. This rule appears to be vestigial and is a candidate for removal.
patterns.name: constant.character.escape.bnd

patterns.comment: Parameter keywords. A space may precede the parenthesis, as in EXPORT SYMBOL (name)
patterns.name: support.function.bnd
